hero.title: Intimacy
hero.strapline: Intimate content, choreographed and consented — the same care a fight gets, given to a love scene.

items.title: Rehearsal & workshops

brands.heading: Consent first, choreography second, camera last.
brands.pullQuote: “A love scene is a stunt with different stakes — you rehearse it, you agree it, and nobody improvises on the day.”
brands.paragraph: We start with the script and the boundaries, not the schedule. The coordinator meets the production and the cast, agrees what is and is not on the table in writing, choreographs the sequence to that agreement, and stays through the shoot so anything that changes is renegotiated rather than assumed. It protects the cast, and it protects the day.

film.heading: Safe, compliant and quick on the floor.
film.paragraph: Intimacy coordination is now standard practice across UK broadcast and streaming, and productions are expected to evidence it. We supply coordinators who know the guidance, work comfortably alongside ADs, stunts and costume, and keep the closed-set process tight enough that it costs you time rather than losing you a day.

definitions.description: Boundaries captured in writing before the scene is blocked, and revisited if anything changes.
Room protocol, monitor discipline and minimum crew, run without slowing the schedule.
Garments, barriers and cover coordinated with costume so nothing is improvised on the floor.
